history.sg_progress: The resident coordinator handbook has not been finalized, as it has become evident that the pace at which guidance must be updated is not compatible with a static product. A handbook risks becoming outdated shortly after publication. Instead, resident coordinators now have access to the Development Coordination Office’s SharePoint knowledge management site, which provides up-to-date and comprehensive guidance. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been overtaken by events and requests its closure by the Board.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration develop a resident coordinator handbook to provide more guidance to resident coordinators ad interim in delivering the expected results.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. Based on the Board’s findings, the Administration took a pragmatic approach to implementing the recommendation and ensuring that resident coordinators ad interim receive real-time guidance and support in their functions, given the fluidity of the country contexts in which they operate and the amount of changes and updates in United Nations policies and guidance across thematic areas. Resident coordinators ad interim can now avail themselves of the Development Coordination Office SharePoint knowledge management website, which contains all the necessary guidance and is constantly updated. In addition, resident coordinators ad interim systematically receive briefings when taking up their duties, as well as continuous support throughout their tenure, from the relevant regional office, and headquarters, of the Development Coordination Office. The guidance framework created on the basis of the recommendation ensures that resident coordinators ad interim are aware of the results expected of them and where they can find support if required.
history.board_assessment: Given that the resident coordinators ad interim can now avail themselves of the Development Coordination Office SharePoint knowledge management website, which contains all the necessary guidance and is constantly updated, they are able to obtain more guidance in delivering the expected results. The Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
